title: Dragon and Jester in Ruins
description: A green dragon wearing a red scarf lounges on a blue couch beside a woman in a pink dress holding a candle, both gazing out a large arched window at a frozen apocalyptic landscape with a shipwreck. A large white jester-like monster with horns and coins for eyes sits atop a massive pile of colorful coins and symbols, illuminated by dramatic spotlight from above.
